description: Rothco’s Tactical Squadron Cap is a lightweight tactical military hat that features no loop field for a clean and classic military appearance. The tactical cap is constructed with a lightweight yet durable polycotton material composition for years of wear. The baseball style military hat with four reinforced vent holes that encourage optimal cooling airflow, and also features a hook and loop back closure on the tactical hat accommodates most head sizes. The crown of the military baseball cap features a loop patch for attaching an IR marker (measures 1.13 inches x 1 inch), while the back features loop field for attaching name tape (measures 3.75 inches x 1 inch). The tactical military cap also features an internal sweatband for added comfort.
